. Load is read from SQLite, scope, rank and cut, per question; the embedding arm also embeds the question
and compares it with every entry in plain Python.
scoped against the whole file: fixed none; broken Q-

The entry each memory question needs was among the 8 loaded on 2 of 5 questions by recency, 5 by BM25
and 5 by embeddings, all within the inquiry. Without scope, 61 of 208 loaded entries came from other
inquiries, 14 of them other officers' private notes and 15 about another inquiry's Pellmar. At 10,250
entries BM25 found 5 of 5 in 110 ms a question, embeddings 5 of 5 in 617 ms. On the signed questions:
the whole file 17 of 26, the scoped store 16 of 26, unscoped 16 of 26. Each session now starts with a
chosen set of memories, and the choice is recorded.
